summary: Full backend + frontend testing for 'La Sfida dei Locali'. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed against public URL covering CRUD for sfide/coupons, redeem happy path + 409 (already used) + 404 (invalid), notifications creation, settings persistence, stats and _id exclusion. Frontend: verified role switcher (Admin/Negoziante/Vincitore), Admin stats cards, Nuova Sfida creation dialog, Assegna Coupon flow (creates SFIDA-XXXXX code), email settings save, Negoziante manual redemption (VALIDO, 'Coupon gia usato', 'Codice coupon non valido'), notifications bell with counter + list, Vincitore ticket with QR + countdown + status badge + tab switching between multiple coupons. All critical flows working end-to-end.
